Company Overview
BOSS Consolidated Services Ltd. (BOSS CS) is a multidisciplinary professional services company headquartered in Canada. Through its many service divisions, it provides integrated services worldwide to meet the diverse needs of individuals, families, students, professionals and businesses, with one goal: to give every client the right direction and trusted guidance.
Vision
To be a global, integrated professional services company that connects clients with the services they need across borders, built on trust, service quality, transparency and mutual benefit.
Mission
To provide free initial consultations and high-quality, integrated services tailored to the needs of individuals and businesses; to expand global service and career opportunities; and, through our Referral Reward Program, to create additional income opportunities for clients, so that our clients and our company grow together through mutual benefit.

Company Structure & Legal Compliance
Every service offered under the BOSS CS group is organized in line with the laws, licensing requirements, professional regulations and administrative practices of the country and jurisdiction in which it operates.
Depending on the nature of each service and its legal requirements, services operate as separately registered companies, subsidiaries or duly authorized branch offices.
Each company carries its own legal and professional responsibilities, while working together under the BOSS CS group's shared management policies, service standards and growth objectives.

Accessing Our Services
To access BOSS CS services, you first register with the company and become a Verified Client. Everyone completes our client registration process, after which the services of all our divisions are available to you.
Client Registration Process
Anyone can become a Verified Client of BOSS CS through the following seven steps. The process confirms the client's identity, helps us understand their needs, and enrolls them properly in the company's Referral Reward Program.
01
Initial Briefing
We explain our services, the opportunities available to clients and the Referral Reward Program, and listen to the client's needs.
02
Identity Verification
The client's identity documents are checked to confirm that the person registering is the person named in the documents.
03
Client Profile
The client's basic information, contact details and service needs are recorded, and a unique client profile is created.
04
Client Agreement
Our terms of service, the client's rights and responsibilities, and our data protection practices are explained, and the agreement is signed with the client's consent.

05
Referral Agreement
The eligibility conditions of the Referral Reward Program, how referral commission is calculated and how it is paid are explained, and the agreement is signed by the parties involved.
06
Service Activation
Once verification and the agreements are complete, the client's profile is activated and they can access the full range of company services.
07
Global Service Access
Verified BOSS CS clients can also receive services at our branches in other countries through the company's international service network.
Introducing a New Client

The person who makes the introduction is called the Referrer, and the person introduced is called the Referee. The Referee becomes a Verified Client after completing registration, identity verification and the agreement process.

04
How Does the Referral Reward Program Work?
01
Introduce a New Client
A Verified Client in any country can introduce a new person, in the same or another country, to BOSS CS.
02
New Client Registration
The person introduced completes the company's client registration process, signs the required agreements and joins as a Verified Client.
03
Receiving Services
The new client chooses the services they need and pays the related service fee.
04
Reward Fund Allocation
For services eligible for referral rewards, 20% of the service fee the company receives is set aside as the referral reward fund (Referral Commission).
05
Reward Distribution
The reward fund is shared among eligible referrers, from the direct referrer up to a maximum of the tenth level, according to set percentages.
International Referral Reward Opportunities
Verified BOSS CS clients can refer people living in other countries to the company's services, not only people in their own country.
When the people they refer receive services from BOSS CS or one of its authorized international branches and pay the service fee, the referrers become eligible for a Referral Reward.

Example: a client in Sri Lanka refers someone in Canada, who receives an eligible service worth CAD 1,000 at a BOSS CS branch in Canada. 20% of that fee (CAD 200) is set aside for the referral reward fund.

The referrer in Sri Lanka is then eligible for the direct referrer's 55% share, a reward of CAD 110. In the same way, clients in Canada can refer people in other countries and earn rewards.

Ongoing Reward Opportunities
Verified BOSS CS clients can earn rewards not only from the clients they introduce directly, but also from other clients who join through their referral network. Whenever these clients receive eligible services, now or in the future, and pay the related fees, rewards are paid to eligible referrers under the program rules. This lets clients grow their referral network and earn ongoing financial benefits, while helping others access the same trusted, fair and integrated professional services they receive.
Our Commitment & Service Policy
BOSS CS is committed to providing quality, integrated professional services and trusted guidance worldwide.
Putting trust, transparency and service quality first, we offer everyone a Free Initial Consultation and provide services and guidance that suit their needs and comply with the law.
Through our Client Referral Reward Program, we also give clients the opportunity to contribute to the company's growth and earn financial benefits. Our aim is to build a global service network founded on trust, cooperation and mutual benefit.
